conclusion: ActorGeneration, STATUS pointer, refcount/backlink and bit equality do not identify a same-actor rebuild or same-value writer. No native revision counter was found in the observed STATUS layout. A conditional, explicit revision observer is required for a stronger guarantee.

observerContract.closure: Known4016B0/401730/3C1190 code callers are contained within3C0010/3C1D90. Known3C2240 callers first initialize a newly allocated slot. A broader boundary contract may also observe3C2240,4016B0 and401730 to tolerate externally initiated calls to these public helpers. The bounded candidate scan is supporting evidence, not a whole-program no-other-writes proof.
observerContract.implementationBlocker: The minimum entry set is direct code, not one replaceable vtable. Derived+280 hooks miss level/reward direct calls; VM record7566E0 covers only the coefficient script adapter. An approved, complete interception mechanism with relocation/unwind/concurrency proof is still required. No hook is implemented or authorized by this report.
runtimeRules: Observe while off-current, menus, host expiry and temporarily unready; do not dereference a remembered Actor merely to increment a pool-slot revision.

Before acquire/reapply/release, require intact observers, fresh game-thread context, current ActorGeneration, exact allocated STATUS/backlinks/role and matching revisions; re-read all selected original/applied bits atomically in that command.
Any observed same-value native or manual write supersedes ownership. Manual Loot/DamageTuning handlers must notify the same revision layer before their direct stores.
A cohort-wide revision may conservatively supersede all five fields. Per-field revisions allow non-overlapping timed rewards to coexist; whole rebuild invalidates every field.

Unknown callback thread, hook/bank/code loss, counter overflow, metadata exception or unsupported writer invalidates confidence and blocks restorative writes. It is uncertainty, not proof of Actor death.
Metadata faults must not suppress native calls; immutable originals forward exactly once, outside metadata exception handling. Native exceptions propagate.

Poolreset/allocation/rebuild receipts are immutable; do not silently remint ownership after native takeover. Host unknown acknowledgements remain unresolved until an authoritative native receipt is obtained.
Existing ActorGeneration still matters because status fields and pointer equality alone cannot distinguish actor ABA; status identity additionally distinguishes same-actor slot reuse/rebuild.

roles.Sora: Shared STATUS layout and all five consumer paths; normal native form/mission rules remain.
roles.Roxas: Shared constructor/rebuild/Draw/party-quantity/damage paths. Match character14 and forms0/10 through existing role classifier; do not infer role from the shared Sora save.
roles.Mickey: Shared structural layout and rebuild; Draw, quantity and damage-coefficient consumers remain applicable. Normal prize3DC170 remaps toDrive orbs and suppresses ordinary Lucky item rolls; retention is bypassed for the remapped7/8 kinds. Do not market Lucky/Tax effects as effective in ordinary rescue-Mickey mode.
roles.admission: Structural role compatibility is not a release-ready timed reward. Ownership observer/receipt implementation and role-specific tests are still required.

limits: No live game or hooks executed; no product/test/build changes.
No universal proof excludes arbitrary external memory writes, corrupted resource-derived indices or unexamined computed-address/bulk writes. Exact retail path pinning is a conditional contract.
The candidate scan covers0x1403A0000..0x140435000;185796 decoded instructions,188 skipped data bytes. It intentionally records offset collisions and does not turn all matches into STATUS writers.
The47-byte allocator tail at3C0250 is not defined as an IDA function; its original bytes are captured as a code fragment, excluded from full-function and claim totals.
No artificial native revision field should be invented from STATUS612(refcount),616(backlink),504(selfpointer) or unused padding.
